start.text: The system is listening. Find the structure.
Every tile changes more than one possibility.
Read the crossings before choosing a number.
Level {level}. The shape of the answer is already here.
Do not rush the first move. Let the board reveal its rhythm.
Difficulty {difficulty}. Your patterns are adapting faster than it is.
One stable line can unlock the entire board.
The obvious move is information, even when it is not the answer.

named_start.text: Welcome back, {player}. The board remembers your rhythm.
{player}, this structure matches the way you search.
{player}, your Mind Level is {mind_level}. Trust what you have trained.

complete.text: Excellent. The board has nothing left to hide.
Another pattern added to your internal library.
The answer looked inevitable after you found it.
Mind Level {mind_level}: the signal is getting clearer.

named_complete.text: {player}, your decisions made the board look simple.
The system predicted pressure. You produced clarity, {player}.
Keep that feeling, {player}. You built it move by move.

fast.text: So fast. You recognized the structure before it settled.
You were already ahead of the board.
Your first instinct carried the whole solution.
The board barely had time to become difficult.

breakthrough.text: That was faster than your usual rhythm. Something just clicked.
A real acceleration. Your baseline just moved.
You solved that before your normal thinking window opened.
New speed detected. Not luck: compression.
You did not merely improve. You changed approach.

precise.text: Clean path. Every move had a purpose.
You solved it without disturbing the structure.
Excellent restraint. You touched only what mattered.
Your accuracy is becoming a habit.

experimental.text: You mapped the board by testing it. Smart exploration.
Bold search, controlled recovery, solid result.
Curiosity found the route that caution could not.

hesitant.text: You are thinking longer than usual. That often precedes a jump.
This pause is not weakness. Your model is reorganizing.
Your rhythm changed. Let the crossings simplify the choice.
You normally move sooner. Look for the one line that constrains two.
The board feels dense because one hidden certainty is doing too much work.

patient.text: You waited for certainty, then moved cleanly.
Slow is smooth. Smooth becomes fast.
You are protecting the structure instead of forcing it.
Deep focus detected. Keep the pace that feels inevitable.

resilient.text: You absorbed the contradiction and still closed every line.
Recovery complete. The wrong branch made the right one clearer.
You did not lose momentum; you converted friction into evidence.
That correction was more valuable than a perfect first guess.
The board pushed back. You learned faster.

returning.text: Your previous rhythm is still here. It will return within a few moves.
Welcome back. Start gently; pattern memory wakes quickly.
The system kept your signature. Continue where your intuition left off.
A short return is enough to reactivate a deep skill.

focus_return.text: Attention restored. You can re-enter through the most constrained line.
The pause changed your viewpoint. Use the fresh angle.
You stepped away more often than usual. The pattern is still waiting, unchanged.

motion.text: Your hands are active today. Let the board move, but keep one line mentally still.
Motion detected. Your visual focus remains remarkably stable.
The device is moving; your reasoning does not have to.

short_session.text: A short session can sharpen one instinct. Make this board that instinct.
Brief return, clear target: one pattern stronger than before.
You do not need a long session to create a lasting improvement.

long_session.text: Long-session focus detected. Protect accuracy; speed will follow.
You have stayed deep for a while. Relax your eyes and read the whole shape.
Endurance is active. Keep the next solution light, not forced.

mastery.text: Difficulty {difficulty}, and still you made the structure coherent.
This depth once required effort. Now it looks like your natural language.
High pressure, stable decisions. That is trained mastery.

forecast.text: Tier {tier} begins with a warm-up. Learn its accent before it raises its voice.
This level prepares the final pressure of tier {tier}.
The next tier changes the logic, not the goal. Your habits will transfer.
Near the tier boundary. Expect denser crossings and fewer obvious anchors.
World {world}, tier {tier}: the board is teaching the skill the finale will test.
A new operator pattern is approaching. Read relationships before values.
Final stretch of this tier. Save speed for the moment certainty appears.
The next structure will look unfamiliar for only a few moves.

random.text: You saw the crossing before the line.
A contradiction can be a useful clue.
You are beginning to think in intersections.
Confidence is quieter than guessing. That move was quiet.
Your attention is becoming part of the interface.
